item.text: There isn’t an existing user `settings.json`, so I’m creating one with the relevant VS Code setting: `workbench.editor.wrapTabs`.

Done. I enabled VS Code tab wrapping by adding:

```json
"workbench.editor.wrapTabs": true
```

in `/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json`. VS Code should pick it up automatically; if not, reload the window.
